entries.name: Ben Skowronek
entries.summary: out

entries.name: Brandon Aiyuk
entries.summary: Aiyuk, who who is currently is on the 49ers' Reserve/Left Squad list, has turned in paperwork to be reinstated, Adam Schefter of ESPN reports.

entries.name: Carnell Tate
entries.summary: out

entries.name: Sam Darnold
entries.summary: Head coach Mike Macdonald announced that Darnold won't play Sunday against the Cardinals due to a quadriceps injury, NFL reporter Andrew Siciliano reports.

entries.name: Tyjae Spears
entries.summary: out

entries.name: Tyler Huntley
entries.summary: Huntley (toe) has reportedly sustained a season-ending turf toe injury, Adam Schefter of ESPN reports.

entries.name: Zachariah Branch
entries.summary: Coach Kevin Stefanski noted Monday that Branch (hamstring) won't play Sunday against the Bengals, William McFadden of the Falcons' official site reports.

entries.name: A.J. Brown
entries.summary: Brown (ankle/knee) won't practice Wednesday, Doug Kyed of the Boston Herald reports.

entries.name: Anthony Gould
entries.summary: questionable

entries.name: Bam Knight
entries.summary: Head coach Mike LaFleur revealed Monday that Knight is in the concussion protocol following Sunday's overtime win in Dallas, Josh Weinfuss of ESPN.com reports.

entries.name: Bhayshul Tuten
entries.summary: Jaguars head coach Liam Coen said Wednesday that Tuten (ankle/foot) is feeling better, but the running back's status for Thursday's contest versus the Ravens is expected to come down to a game-time decision, John Shipley of SI.com reports.

entries.name: Breece Hall
entries.summary: Hall (quadriceps) is slated to be limited at practice Wednesday, ack Rosenblatt of The Athletic reports.

entries.name: Brenen Thompson
entries.summary: Thompson (quadriceps/hamstring) is not expected to practice this week, Noah Furtado of The Athletic reports.

entries.name: Brian Robinson Jr.
entries.summary: The Falcons listed Robinson (hamstring) as a limited participant on Wednesday's estimated practice report, Tori McElhaney of the team's official site reports.

entries.name: Cam Skattebo
entries.summary: Skattebo (hamstring) didn't take part in Wednesday's practice and instead was seen working with a trainer on the side, Jordan Raanan of ESPN reports.

entries.name: Chris Rodriguez Jr.
entries.summary: Rodriguez (hand) was listed as a limited participant in Tuesday's practice.

entries.name: Christian McCaffrey
entries.summary: McCaffrey is dealing with a mild hamstring strain rather than a quadriceps injury, and the 49ers believe he'll be ready following the team's Week 8 bye, David Lombardi of SF Standard reports.

entries.name: Christian Watson
entries.summary: Packers passing game coordinator Jason Vrable said Monday that Watson (ribs) is sore but "doing great," Matt Schneidman of The Athletic reports.

entries.name: CJ Donaldson
entries.summary: Donaldson (shoulder) is questionable to return to Sunday's game against the Steelers in Paris.

entries.name: Colby Parkinson
entries.summary: questionable

entries.name: David Montgomery
entries.summary: Montgomery (groin) wasn't present for the portion of Wednesday's practice open to the media, Jonathan M. Alexander of the Houston Chronicle reports.

entries.name: Deebo Samuel Sr.
entries.summary: Samuel (hamstring) has a chance to return following the 49ers' Week 8 bye, Matt Maiocco of NBC Sports Bay Area reports.

entries.name: Deshaun Watson
entries.summary: Mary Kay Cabot of the Cleveland Plain Dealer suggests that Watson may have difficulty clearing the NFL's concussion protocol ahead of Sunday's game against the Saints.

entries.name: DeVonta Smith
entries.summary: questionable

entries.name: DJ Moore
entries.summary: Moore indicated following Sunday's 36-10 win over the Ravens that he's okay in the wake of his late-game exit due to a knee issue, Cameron Wolfe of NFL Network reports.

entries.name: Dontayvion Wicks
entries.summary: questionable

entries.name: Drew Lock
entries.summary: Lock (elbow) is slated to start Sunday's game against the Cardinals, perNFL reporter Andrew Siciliano.

entries.name: Emeka Egbuka
entries.summary: Head coach Todd Bowles said Egbuka (foot) didn't practice Wednesday, but the wide receiver was able to run on a side field, and the Buccaneers will see how he feels Thursday, Scott Smith of the Buccaneers' official site reports.

entries.name: Garrett Wilson
entries.summary: Wilson, who is in the NFL's concussion protocol, is considered day-to-day,  Zack Rosenblatt of The Athletic reports.

entries.name: Hunter Henry
entries.summary: Patriots head coach Mike Vrabel said Monday that he had no update on Henry's (foot) status heading into Sunday's game against the Packers, Karen Guregian of MassLive.com reports. "I don't have any expectations yet," Vrabel said of Henry. "It's kind of how he responds here. He wasn't able to finish the [Week 8] game. So we'll see where he is, and I know Hunter will do everything he can to get back to help us."

entries.name: Jacob Saylors
entries.summary: Saylors (neck) is not expected to practice Wednesday, Nolan Bianchi of The Detroit News reports.

entries.name: Jake Ferguson
entries.summary: Head coach Brian Schottenheimer said Ferguson (ankle) will work with the Cowboys' training staff during Wednesday's practice, Briana Aldridge of CBS News Texas reports.

entries.name: Jakobi Meyers
entries.summary: Meyers (hamstring/ankle) was listed as a limited participant in Tuesday's practice.

entries.name: Joshua Palmer
entries.summary: Palmer (hamstring) has been ruled out for the rest of Sunday's game against the Ravens.

entries.name: KaVontae Turpin
entries.summary: questionable

entries.name: Kyle Monangai
entries.summary: questionable

entries.name: Kyler Murray
entries.summary: Head coach Kevin O'Connell said Monday that Murray has a sore hamstring and will undergo a full evaluation as the Vikings look to determine the extent of the issue, Alec Lewis of The Athletic reports.

entries.name: Luke Schoonmaker
entries.summary: questionable

entries.name: Matthew Stafford
entries.summary: Stafford left the locker room after Sunday's 24-9 win over the Chargers with a bag of ice wrapped on his right arm, and Rams coach Sean McVay acknowledged Monday that the quarterback has been dealing with some arm soreness, Adam Grosbard of The Orange County Register reports.

entries.name: Michael Wilson
entries.summary: Wilson said after Sunday's 33-30 win at Dallas that he suffered two broken ribs during the contest, Josh Weinfuss of ESPN.com reports.

entries.name: Mike Evans
entries.summary: Evans (Achilles) is expected to return after San Francisco's Week 8 bye, David Lombardi of SF Standard reports.

entries.name: Rashid Shaheed
entries.summary: Seahawks head coach Mike Macdonald said Tuesday that Shaheed (knee) has a chance to play Sunday against the Cardinals, Brady Henderson of ESPN.com reports.

entries.name: Theo Johnson
entries.summary: Johnson (neck) participated during practice Monday, Dan Duggan of The Athletic reports.

entries.name: TreVeyon Henderson
entries.summary: Henderson (illness) won't practice Wednesday, Doug Kyed of the Boston Herald reports.

entries.name: Alec Pierce
entries.summary: When asked Wednesday when Pierce (heel) might be able to resume to practice, Colts head coach Shane Steichen noted that he "can't put a timetable on it right now," Kevin Bowen of 107.5 The Fan Indianapolis reports.

entries.name: Andrei Iosivas
entries.summary: Iosivas (thumb) is making good progress in his rehab, Mike Petraglia of CLNSCincy.com reports.

entries.name: Beaux Collins
entries.summary: Collins (hip) has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Buccaneers and will remain on injured reserve, Tori McElhaney of the Falcons' official site reports.

entries.name: Carter Runyon
entries.summary: Runyon (foot) has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Jets, Sam Warren of The Athletic reports.

entries.name: Davante Adams
entries.summary: Head coach Sean McVay said Wednesday that Adams had successful surgery on his left hamstring, and the Rams are hopeful that the wide receiver will be able to return on the early side of his 6-to-10-week recovery timetable, Adam Grosbard of The Orange County Register reports.

entries.name: David Njoku
entries.summary: Coach Jim Harbaugh said Monday that the Chargers likely will open the 21-day window for Njoku (fibula) this week, Alex Insdorf of BoltBeat.com reports.

entries.name: De'Zhaun Stribling
entries.summary: Stribling (ankle) was spotted Monday walking without crutches or a brace on his lower leg, Matt Barrows of The Athletic reports.

entries.name: Dean Connors
entries.summary: Connors (hand) was placed on IR on Tuesday, Blaine Grisak of SI.com reports.

entries.name: Demarcus Robinson
entries.summary: 49ers coach Kyle Shanahan reiterated Monday that Robinson (ankle) has a chance to return following the team's Week 8 bye, David Lombardi of SFStandard.com reports.

entries.name: Erick All Jr.
entries.summary: Bengals head coach Zac Taylor confirmed Wednesday that All has been diagnosed with a torn ACL in his right knee and will require season-ending surgery, Jay Morrison of SI.com reports.

entries.name: Isiah Pacheco
entries.summary: Lions coach Dan Campbell said Friday that Pacheco (back) has a chance to return in late December, Justin Rogers of DetroitFootball.net reports.

entries.name: James Conner
entries.summary: Cardinals head coach Mike LaFleur said Tuesday that Conner (foot) won't return from IR this week, Darren Urban of the team's official site reports.

entries.name: Jaylin Lane
entries.summary: Lane underwent surgery Oct. 9 to repair his fractured and dislocated ankle, and he is expected to be cleared for activities before OTAs, Tashan Reed of The Washington Post reports.

entries.name: Jaylin Noel
entries.summary: Noel, who was placed on injured reserve earlier Wednesday, is expected to require surgery to address his toe injury and will miss the remainder of the season, Jonathan M. Alexander of the Houston Chronicle reports.

entries.name: Jeremiyah Love
entries.summary: Arizona placed Love (ankle) on injured reserve Tuesday, Darren Urban of the Cardinals' official site reports.

entries.name: Jeremy McNichols
entries.summary: McNichols, who suffered a foot injury Sunday against the Eagles that may require surgery, is out for the season, Ian Rapoport of NFL Network reports.

entries.name: Jonathon Brooks
entries.summary: Brooks (core) was seen working off to the side during the Panthers' unofficial practice Tuesday, Joe Person of The Athletic reports.

entries.name: Jordyn Tyson
entries.summary: Tyson (hamstring) is slated to resume practicing with the Saints on Wednesday, Nick Underhill of NewOrleans.Football reports.

entries.name: Kendrick Bourne
entries.summary: Arizona placed Bourne (tibia) on injured reserve Tuesday, Darren Urban of the Cardinals' official site reports.

entries.name: Mack Hollins
entries.summary: Hollins (calf) is slated to return to practice Wednesday, Ian Rapoport of NFL Network reports.

entries.name: Michael Pittman Jr.
entries.summary: Pittman (foot) said Monday that he resumed running last week as part of a program to return, but the wideout acknowledged that he's without a clear timeline to be activated from injured reserve, Ray Fittipaldo of the Pittsburgh Post-Gazette reports.

entries.name: RJ Harvey
entries.summary: The Broncos placed Harvey (knee) on injured reserve Saturday, Ian Rapoport of NFL Network reports.

entries.name: Terrance Ferguson
entries.summary: Coach Sean McVay said Monday that it is "looking more likely than not" Ferguson (ankle) will practice this week, Sarah Barshop of ESPN.com reports.

entries.name: Terry McLaurin
entries.summary: McLaurin (knee) underwent surgery Friday to repair the torn patellar tendon in his left knee, Nicki Jhabvala of The Athletic reports.

entries.name: Travis Etienne Jr.
entries.summary: Head coach Kellen Moore said that Etienne (hamstring) will be evaluated Monday before the Saints make a determination whether he practices this week, Ross Jackson of WWL Louisiana reports.

entries.name: Tyrone Tracy Jr.
entries.summary: The Giants placed Tracy (hamstring) on injured reserve Tuesday, Dan Salomone of the team's official site reports.

entries.name: Xavier Legette
entries.summary: Panthers head coach Dave Canales said Monday that Legette (knee) will "potentially" be designated for return from injured reserve this week, Joe Person of The Athletic reports.
